verses.verse:
पंचमद्वय मध्ये तु षडजस्य स्थिति र्भवेत।
मन्द्र पंचम षडजयो र्मध्ये धैवत इष्यते।।२४।।
verses.text: Between the two Pañcamas lies Ṣaḍja; between lower Pañcama and Ṣaḍja, Dhaivata is wanted.

commentary.text: That is, Ṣaḍja lies in the middle between the lower Pañcama and the upper Pañcama, and Dhaivata belongs midway between the lower Pañcama and Ṣaḍja. Here some inquirers may ask: since the distance from Dhaivata to Pañcama, counting komal Dhaivata, is two svarāntaras (intervals), and the distance from Dhaivata to Ṣaḍja, because of the two Niṣādas in between, is three intervals, why then has Dhaivata been placed midway between Ṣaḍja and Pañcama? This doubt is resolved as follows: once the hole of the Dhaivata note is made, the length of the pipe is reduced, and the result of this shortening is that within the same distance in which two notes lie below Dha, three notes can be placed above. Here a spiritual thought too will hold good: if a poor man loses ten paise and a rich man loses 10 rupees, both will feel equal distress. In the same way, in the pipe too the successive limits are seen to grow smaller: though to the ear the intervals between notes are equal, to the eye, as on a stringed instrument, the distance appears to shrink. On this basis, further on, four notes are placed within this same distance.
